channel.title: Nubenetes Intelligence Digest
channel.description: AI-curated top picks from the Cloud Native & Kubernetes ecosystem

item.title: kubernetes-sigs/kueue: Kubernetes-native Job Queueing
item.description: [CRITICAL] Kueue establishes Kubernetes-native batch queueing and multi-tenant quota management, directly transforming how enterprises orchestrate large-scale AI/ML and HPC workloads.

item.title: Karmada
item.description: [CRITICAL] Karmada provides a CNCF-backed multi-cluster federation engine that enables resilient workload scheduling and high availability across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.

item.title: kubernetes-sigs/kubebuilder
item.description: [CRITICAL] Kubebuilder serves as the industry-standard SDK and scaffolding framework for building production-grade Kubernetes APIs, Custom Resource Definitions, and operators.

item.title: github.com/kubernetes: **Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler**
item.description: [CRITICAL] As the official Kubernetes node autoscaling component, Cluster Autoscaler remains foundational for dynamically matching cloud compute capacity to production scheduling demand.

item.title: Red Hat OpenShift AI (RHOAI)
item.description: [CRITICAL] Unifies KServe, vLLM, Kubeflow, and KubeRay into a production-ready, Kubernetes-native enterprise AI and MLOps platform.

item.title: Microsoft Agent Framework
item.description: [CRITICAL] Consolidates Semantic Kernel and AutoGen into a single enterprise-grade, multi-language SDK and runtime for multi-agent systems.

item.title: Kubernetes Gateway API
item.description: [CRITICAL] Kubernetes Gateway API is the foundational standard replacing legacy Ingress with expressive, role-oriented routing across cloud-native platforms.

item.title: Databricks Mosaic AI
item.description: [CRITICAL] Delivers a unified enterprise platform for building, governing, and evaluating production AI agents, RAG pipelines, and fine-tuned models alongside Lakehouse data.

item.title: vLLM on Kubernetes
item.description: [CRITICAL] Standardizes high-throughput, memory-efficient LLM inference serving across Kubernetes clusters using PagedAttention.

item.title: OpenTofu Official GitHub Repository
item.description: [CRITICAL] Governed by the Linux Foundation, OpenTofu represents a pivotal industry shift toward open-source IaC with major innovations like native state encryption.

item.title: HashiCorp Terraform Language: Terraform Stacks Overview
item.description: [CRITICAL] Introduces a foundational paradigm shift in HashiCorp Terraform for orchestrating multi-tier, multi-region cloud infrastructure declaratively.

item.title: Nubenetes Istio Ambient Mesh and Gateway API on OpenShift (Playlist)
item.description: [CRITICAL] This Nubenetes masterclass provides practical architectural guidance on Red Hat OpenShift Service Mesh 3.0, Gateway API, and sidecarless Istio Ambient Mesh with Rust ztunnel.

item.title: Kubernetes v1.37: Pod Certificates and Cluster Trust Bundles
item.description: [CRITICAL] Kubernetes v1.37 introduces native Pod Certificates and Cluster Trust Bundles, fundamentally decentralizing mTLS and PKI trust distribution within the control plane.

item.title: Kubernetes v1.37: KubeletInUserNamespace (aka Rootless mode) Graduates to Beta
item.description: [CRITICAL] Graduating KubeletInUserNamespace (Rootless mode) to Beta in Kubernetes v1.37 dramatically shrinks the node compromise blast radius by running the kubelet outside root privileges.

item.title: hashicorp/vault
item.description: [CRITICAL] HashiCorp Vault remains the enterprise backbone for Zero Trust architectures, providing dynamic credential brokering and secrets management across multi-cloud and Kubernetes workloads.

item.title: github: Flux Version 2
item.description: [CRITICAL] Flux v2 is a foundational CNCF GitOps toolkit enabling decoupled, parallel Kubernetes configuration reconciliation at enterprise scale.

item.title: dagger/dagger: Dagger is a portable devkit for CICD
item.description: [CRITICAL] Dagger transforms CI/CD pipelines from brittle YAML into portable, BuildKit-powered code written in general-purpose languages.

item.title: Kubernetes v1.37: Native Histograms Graduates to Beta
item.description: [CRITICAL] Graduating Native Histograms (KEP-5808) to Beta in Kubernetes v1.37 fundamentally solves Prometheus metric cardinality explosions while enabling accurate tail-latency observability across clusters.

item.title: Kubernetes v1.37: Metrics API graduates to stable
item.description: [CRITICAL] Promoting the Kubernetes Metrics API to GA (v1) in v1.37 establishes long-term enterprise stability and backward compatibility for Horizontal Pod Autoscaling and core resource telemetry.

item.title: Gateway API v1.6: TCPRoute and UDPRoute Graduate to Standard
item.description: [CRITICAL] Graduating TCPRoute and UDPRoute to Standard in Gateway API v1.6 fundamentally expands Kubernetes-native traffic management beyond HTTP to production Layer 4 workloads.
